product_metadata.title: G-TING Pot Rack Organizers, 8 Tiers Pots and Pans Organizer for Kitchen Organization & Storage, Adjustable Pot Lid Holders & Pan Rack, Lid Organizer for Pots and Pans With 3 DIY Methods(Silver)
features: √[ Adjustable Tiers ]: This pan rack organizer comes with 8 adjustable tiers, you can install the pan organizer according to the size of your pots and pans. No matter how big your pot is, it can still fit into your pot organizer.

√[ 3 DIY Methods ]: This kitchen rack has 3 DIY methods. You can install 8 tiers at both sides or just install 4 tiers at one side. You can place the pot rack in the way you like. Lay it down or make it standing is all up to you. A perfect kitchen counter organizer for kitchen organization and storage.

√[ Easy to install ]: How easy to install this pot organizer? Even a little kid can install the pot holder in a couple minutes. All essential parts of the pantry organizer is in the box. No need for extra tools.

√[ Solid Construction ]: This cookware organizer made by heavy duty iron with plating process finished which will not rust. It’s very firm and elegant. Solid Triangular design which is more stable and less likely to fall.

√[U Shape Groove Design with non-slip silicone pad]: While pot holder is being used as lid holder, the U shape groove design with non- slip silicone pad of the pot lid rack is able to hold the pot lids steadily in place. Load Bearing up to 9 LB. Tips: manual measurement, there may be an error of 1-2cm and may be an error of 0.1-0.5 lb.
